Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the handling of serialized objects provided to the TopoDebugServlet endpoint. When parsing the className parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to render a page.
